newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tanabe shares up on deal with UK Biotech.
newsitem.headline: Tanabe shares up on deal with UK Biotech.

text.p: Shares in Tanabe Seiyaku Co Ltd jumped on Friday morning, helped by the news that the firm had signed a deal with pharmaceutical group Biotech Plc to develop the British firm's oral anti-cancer drug Marimastat in Japan, traders said.
The share price was up 31 yen at 925 yen at midday, the tenth largest percentage gainer. The volume was 1.086 million shares.
Biotech said in a statement on Thursday that it had received an initial payment of $7.0 million from Tanabe, to be followed by up to a further $67 million.
Tanabe, which will receive exclusive marketing rights to the drug, will develop it Japan and is expected to start trials with cancer patients next year.
Marimastat, Biotech's most important drug, is currently being used in a series of Phase III clinical trials on cancer patients in Europe and North America.
